## Compliance
Fixed indexed annuities are insurance products, not investments. They are not FDIC insured and involve fees, surrender charges, and terms that vary by carrier and state. Consult with a licensed insurance agent to determine if an annuity is suitable for your specific situation. Educational content only, not financial, tax, or legal advice. Licensed states: NC, SC, GA, FL, VA, MD, MI, KS, TX, OH. NPN 18530055 (agent) / 20387435 (agency). Prosperity Services Group is not affiliated with or endorsed by Medicare or any government agency.
